name: Mouth-blown cylinder (antique) sheet
process: The glassmaker gathers glass from the pot on a blowpipe and inflates it slowly to the size of a balloon, turning it by hand in a mould that gives the surface its structure; the balloon is swung and blown into a cylinder, its end cut open and widened, and the pipe knocked off. When cool the cylinder is cut open along its length, reheated in a flattening kiln, laid open and relaxed, and the wavy sheet flattened with a piece of wood, then annealed. Each sheet is unique: its seeds, reams and waviness, and its thickness, about 2 mm in the middle and up to 5 mm near the natural edge.
processSources: H. J. Powell, W. Rosenhain and A. Nesbitt, 'Glass', Encyclopaedia Britannica, 11th ed. (1911), via Wikisource, https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/1911_Encyclop%C3%A6dia_Britannica/Glass

steps.step: blow a balloon, turning it in a mould for the surface structure; blow out to a cylinder
'the cylinder is cut open length-ways and then heated again, laid open and relaxed'; flattened with wood
the 1911 account: the glass is extended into a long cylinder, split longitudinally and 'flattened down ... by the careful application of pressure'
steps.source: H. J. Powell, W. Rosenhain and A. Nesbitt, 'Glass', Encyclopaedia Britannica, 11th ed. (1911), via Wikisource, https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/1911_Encyclop%C3%A6dia_Britannica/Glass

seeds.text: From no seeds to strong seedy, to order; round or oval bubbles.

distortion.text: Slight distortions, scattered bubbles and streaks; subtle occasional reams in the smoother grade.

stock.text: About 60 x 90 cm, about 3 mm (Genuine Antique); Restauro 2 mm up to about 85 x 100 cm.
stock.source: Glashuette Lamberts, 'Genuine antique glass', https://lamberts.de/genuine-antique-glass ; Glashuette Lamberts, 'Restauro window glass', https://lamberts.de/restauro-r-window-glass

photograph: Reflections that bend and wobble across a pane; seeds catching the light; colour deepening where the sheet is thicker.

unverified.text: waviness amplitude and wavelength of antique sheet
unverified.reason: No measured waviness (amplitude and wavelength) of cylinder sheet was read; the as-built normal ripple (0.012) is a design value.
